paragraphs.en: When I was a child, I spent every summer at my grandparents' house in a village near Fergana. My favourite day was Sunday, because on Sundays my grandmother made plov for the whole family.
paragraphs.uz: Bolaligimda har yozni Farg'ona yaqinidagi qishloqda, bobo-buvimning uyida o'tkazardim. Eng sevimli kunim yakshanba edi, chunki yakshanba kunlari buvim butun oila uchun palov qilardi.

paragraphs.en: Last summer, I asked her to teach me. "First, you have to cut the onions and carrots," she said. I cut the carrots into long thin pieces. It took me almost an hour!
paragraphs.uz: O'tgan yozda undan menga o'rgatishini so'radim. "Avval piyoz va sabzini to'g'rashing kerak," dedi u. Men sabzini uzun ingichka qilib to'g'radim. Bu menga deyarli bir soat vaqt oldi!

paragraphs.en: Then she heated the oil in a big kazan and fried the meat. After that, we added the onions and carrots. The kitchen smelled wonderful.
paragraphs.uz: Keyin u katta qozonda yog'ni qizdirdi va go'shtni qovurdi. Shundan so'ng piyoz va sabzini qo'shdik. Oshxonadan ajoyib hid taraldi.

paragraphs.en: Finally, she added the rice and water and closed the kazan. "Now we wait," she said. "Good plov needs patience."
paragraphs.uz: Nihoyat, u guruch va suvni qo'shib, qozonni yopdi. "Endi kutamiz," dedi u. "Yaxshi palov sabr talab qiladi."

paragraphs.en: My plov wasn't as good as hers, but everyone ate it and said it was delicious. Grandma smiled. "Next year, you'll make it alone," she said.
paragraphs.uz: Mening palovim unikidek yaxshi chiqmadi, lekin hamma yedi va mazali dedi. Buvim jilmaydi. "Kelasi yil o'zing yolg'iz qilasan," dedi u.
